reviews.text: Game Changer. This is a Must have!
Great Analyzer. I love the fact that it helps me take care of my skin. It also allows me to see what products can help improve my skin.
Piece of cake.. It’s been a while since I’ve done this. Loved my results. Looks like I can go back to a Timewise set rather than Timewise Repair. Yay!
Love it!. Love it! But needs to work on the alignment for the eyes. And better analysis of the eye area.
Amazing!!. Love it!!!
Skin analyzer. Works perfectly to determine what your skin needs. Works great and the products are excellent.

Update. I left a two star review earlier because I couldn't get the camera and skin analysis to work. 
The reason why it didn't work was because I needed to update the app. 
Once I did that, it worked perfectly! I'm pleased and planning on sharing it with my family and friends.
Director. Great app. !
Bug glitches. App used to work well. Now the camera is constantly glitching and can’t get an accurate reading of the skin. Errors pop up

Disappointed. Every time my the camera snaps my face it tells me there was an error and to take a photo again. All instructions have been followed and it says the same thing no matter how many times I retake the photo.
Espectacular. Es muy buena la aplicación porque te da exactamente el tratamiento que necesitas

Delia Ramirez. I love this app!!! Takes you deep in your skin and details damages not often seen by the naked eye and best of all tells you what to use to eliminate the problem!

It also can be used as a method of measuring as a before and after instrument to see progress!
Takes to long. It takes a long time for the picture to take even when your face is in the right position.
Buggy. I’m a consultant and I continue to have problems getting the app to work. It doesn’t seem to save the data when I use it and has so much trouble taking the photos.
Skin Analysis. Muy bueno. Excelente

Best app for skin care analysis out there!!!. It took me time at the beginning to learn how to use it. Even though I follow all the structures, I could not make it work. So I called customer service and a really nice lady explained to me that I have to have my eyes look direct to him the lens camera in order to work. So I follow her instructions and now it works perfectly. Just make sure you’re looking direct to the camera lens, and not looking down or sideways👀😁
Unsuccessful. Couldn’t get past first steps after face alignment keep saying whoops x12 tries
Mary Kay skin app. Works well. Sometimes hard to get picture of face.
Before and after. I’m a science teacher and love this app! I can take as many shots as I want to compare what happens after using different products.
Súper herramienta. Esta aplicación te simplifica la vida. Le da al cliente justo lo que necesitas. La amo.
Difficulty. I have tried to use it but can’t get it to take photo

Difficult to use. I have on numerous occasions had difficulty with proper alignment, lighting to take a clients photo. 
It makes me feel unprofessional and frustrates the client as well
I have an iphone 12 pro with great lighting, so I am unsure of the issue.
SkinAnalyzer. Innovative approach for consumers to be able to see themselves, their imperfections and come up with a professional plan to improve their skin.
Waste of time and storage space. The app didn’t work. Wouldn’t let me take a photo.

Does Not Work. I used it exactly as instructed, face perfectly within oval, eyes on horizontal line, selfie mode. I held it there until my arm grew tired. Nothing. I have an iPhone 11 Pro Max. I do not understand the positive reviews.
How & Why. I absolutely love this! I love that it explains the how and why if aging signs. Can we get the results to share to our consultant, not just the recommended products?
Love this app!!!. Amazing tool for virtual skin care and in person! Allows for a better understanding of skin issues and gives awesome recommendations!
Analyzer. Took picture but when I sent it it was blackened out. No photo
Take to long to take pic. It is difficult at times.
Continuing problem. The app will not open. It flashes closed.
Remove the guess work. Skin Analyzer gives an accurate report of what your skin needs to look it’s best

Available for Men. Will this be set up for men to use? I have men wanting to use this app to know a regimen but it is only offering for women. I would think adding the option to select sex could open a whole market.
Results. When asking a customer to text results, the app only allows for the recommended product list to be shared. It does not share the skin summary.
Might be good if it would work.. For some reason even though my face is in the oval and the lighting is good and my eyes are aligned it won’t take a picture. I’d forget this one.

LOVE THIS APP!. I love the convenience of this app! I can put orders together at any time whenever I remember I need more of a certain product on my shelf and then transfer it to in touch and pick up right where I left off whenever I’m ready to finalize it! Just another tool to provide convenience to the salesforce, thank you Mary Kay!
Inaccurate. It tells you to pick a Skin type but if you don’t know your skin type how can you pick one to begin?

Refused to work. It says the quality of my camera will not support it...how does it know the quality of a photo is bad when it won’t even take the photo. My iPad is a current one too with a good camera. Extremely disappointed

It’s okay but basic. I’d love to see more details like enlarged pores, sagging skin areas, hooded eyes for not only skincare but also for determining makeup recommendations. The system also should pick up on skin type since we may be subjectively thinking we have dry skin when perhaps we really have combination skin. This app also makes too many recommendations so it’s not that fine tuned.
I love it❣️. Be sure and fill the oval with your entire face & you get an auto photo, it’s get❗️❗️❗️Don’t take my word for it ❣️ And it’s 100% guaranteed a win-win situation
Awesome info!. I learned so much about my skin and products I need to use!
Awesome. Let’s you analyze and develop a skin care routine ❤️
No time. It doesn’t give you time to get your self centered in the circle before it takes the picture
Picture. It takes my picture before I’m ready
Review. Can’t get it to work. Help!
Love It!. This App has definitely opened up communication with my customers. Now they can see what the products can work on and together we can come up with the best regimen for them!

Skin Analyzer App review. I love this APP! It really helps me to know what products to offer to my clients as well as myself. I use it frequently to check the progress of how products are working. I think it is very helpful when doing the follow up check in with clients to make sure the products are working the way they want them to work.
Booo. Very fickle to use and I wish you could just share a link to a website and send the results to your consultant
This app is a joke. This app is a joke,waste of your time different results every time you use it.
Not working. No picture
Thanks for the upgrades!. So much easier to use now! The photo is taken so much faster than before. Thank you for the selfie mode! What a help!!! Using it to check my own progress with my skin care 💗

Skin Analyzer. How amazing to have the Mary Kay computer tell us what products are right for all of our problem areas on our skin. 
It takes great lighting like being outside to get enough light but works amazingly! 
 I am telling everybody how to download this app to their own phone. And the Mary Kay Mirror Me App and the Mary Kay ecatloge‼️😀

Great idea, poor performance. I’ve yet to be able to get this app to take a photo that would work to analyze. Customers are also having issues. As a consultant, this is very frustrating & makes me not want to use what could potentially be a great tool if it actually worked. Also, no clear information as to how to link the app to my website for my customers. Mary Kay, training on this would be incredibly helpful.
I love this app. I

My Suggestion. Dear Developer(s) of the skin analyzer app:

My customers complain of not being able to take a picture regardless of following the instructions. I had a difficult time myself when trying to get a picture to be analyzed. I was just wondering if there is another way to take the picture. Maybe allow the user of the app to up load a picture to be analyzed or make it so the user can just snap a picture in the app instead of allowing the app to snap the picture automatically. This will help me and my customers a lot. I want to utilize the app to help my customers decide which MaryKay products to purchase. Thanks!

Suggestions. Love this app! Makes interacting with my customers very professional. Did notice a glitch today with a younger client. Her wrinkle level was low but it still recommended Timewise products vs clear proof or botanicals. Maybe adding an age selection to better guide the feedback. I think when skin tone issues are above moderate it needs to recommend clear proof.

Doesn’t work. I’ve gotten my face lined up correctly and taken 20+ pictures, and it gives an error every time.

I tried deleting and re-installing the app several times.

Good, it’s free & better than expected. I was skeptical after reading the reviews but it was fun and informative. I was not expecting results that you would get at the doctor so I found it better than expected. I loved the results breakdown with wrinkles identity. You CAN email this to your Consultant or yourself now as some reviewers said it was not available. It was cool to see that my wrinkles changed if I smiled or not. Did not have any issue with lining up my face. I like that you can “start over” but I do wish you could save since you can get different results. Not a game changer though. I mean it is free!
Mary Kay Skin Analysis. I love this app! As a customer this app made it easy for me to find the right product for my skin.
Skin Analyzer. A true eye opener to obtain excellent skincare!!!

Very innovative experience!. With a quarantine life style this app allows you to communicate with customers like never before. It can be eye opening when it does highlight and confirm your skin concerns. I do recommend to be in good lighting to obtain the most accurate results. Very new to this app and can’t wait to see how my friends and family like it.

Awesome analysis. I was able to see where I needed extra help with my facial skin and the products were suggested that would provide help with the areas that needed attention! Also the app provided the order in which the products should be provided!

Face alignment. No picture due to no face alignment. What is the problem?I have an iphone 8.5 plus. It takes wonderful pictures, thus that shouldn't be a problem. No problem with eye alignment and lighting.

Amazing app!. The app is great, it’s so easy to use and manage, besides I never knew all these things about my skin type before. I guess it’s so crazy to me that an app can do all of these things with just a picture of you.
Fantástico. Espectacular
Lighting difficulty. Love this app with only minor issues with having to hold a light aimed at them from the side to correct and also would like to see an age group added to it!

Doesn’t work. I tried to use the skin analyzer. I had the green lights on for face and eye placement. I held for a good minute. I did this several times. I deleted app and uploaded it again. Still nothing
Me fascino. Me fascino! y es una forma de hayudar a nuestros clientes! Y a nosotros a dar mejor servicio.

Inaccurate. The idea is great, but the app is inaccurate and it’s incredibly hard to position for a photo. I think it would be much better if it let you upload a photo you take yourself outside of the app. Especially for people with glasses who can’t see the screen and why it isn’t working. Finally got the photo after 5 mins only for it to tell me I have wrinkles (which I don’t)and highlight places on my face where I have acne bumps as the “wrinkles”. It also told me I have even skin tone (which I don’t AT ALL - I have quite a few dark spots and a lot of redness on my cheeks etc). Honestly this was a waste of my time and quite a garbage experience.

Love this app, could use a few improvements. Love this app, first as a customer and now as a consultant. Two suggestions though: when taking the face scan, allow the user to get proper alignment and click to snap. The app seems to auto-snap too soon sometimes. Second, app should share the actual analysis with consultant, not just the recommended products. It’s a pain having the customer take screenshots of all the pages to send.
Deleted this app. The app would not let me do anything without enabling push notifications. I refuse to use an app that won’t let me opt out of push notifications.

Doesn’t work. This would be a great app if it worked on my phone. I have an almost brand new iPhone 11 Pro and it will not take my picture. Tried all the troubleshooting suggestions and it still does not work. Disappointed and frustrated.
Wow!. I am so glad this app exists! MK is really paving the way. I think it’s pretty accurate givin some of the items were already recommended to my by My consultant, Shawna Brenden.
Skin. They doble products when they recommend it
Incredibly Helpful App!. This App was so easy to use! It gave me a plan of attack to help my skin care program to be more specific to my needs. I am excited to build it into a habit after 21 days.
CEO. WOW! Accurate results in SECONDS, I’m impressed. I already know my skin & needs & the recommendations were correct- great app!
MK Skin Analyzer. Simply amazing, easy, fun and accurate!
Love it!!. Súper Funtional..

Share. The share button does not summarize all of the client’s information. It only sends a potion of one page of suggested products. No meaningful information about the condition of their skin or even just the suggested regimen.

Version 1.4 and iPhone 6. Hi! I’ve downloaded this app for the first time. It just so happens the 1.4 version just came out 4 days ago. I have an iPhone 6 and IOS 12. This meets the specs for this app. I’m getting a message that the quality of my front facing camera isn’t adequate. Any help would be appreciated because I can’t even get a scan in natural daylight.
??. It’s trying to make me sign in as a consultant but I’m clearly not one and I can not access the app

I’d pay for this app. I’d pay for this app if you could get it to work 90% of the time. It’s an awesome app but I can scan the first person and it works perfectly, then it craps out on everyone else. Even though the lighting, eye alignment & face alignment is on point. 

The few times that I’m successful I always get a sale with the recommendations. Sometimes they purchase all the recommended products. 

Please fix the bugs,

Problems with this app. This app is not always User Friendly. If you do not have the proper lighting, it does not work. The potential Customer gets frustrated when it does not work also.Maybe it needs a built in flash to assist with the lighting. Please Help, because this app is excellent when you can get it o work.💗

SkinSight Review. I had extreme difficulty taking a photo of my friend who is black. We tried outside light, indoor light, bathroom light, etc. but the app would not take the picture. So I tried it on my daughter and it immediately took the photo.

Picture difficulties. Love this app, but sometimes it is difficult to get the proper alignment or lighting to activate the photo. Often it requires multiple tries. A couple of times we weren’t able to get the app to take a photo to continue with the analysis. Other than that, this app is great!

Very helpful app. I love this app! Not only does it show me areas where my skin can improve, it maps it out. There is a downloadable list of suggested products for me to combat the signs of aging, from uneven skin tone to texture, to wrinkles. Thank you for some guidance in a world of skincare questions!
Me encanta esto es lo mejor, ha elevado mis ventas. Excelente
Focus problem with faces. It is very difficult to get the face aligned. Did it yesterday and finally gave to customer who did it looking in a mirror. Great information-when it works.

Skin sight. Very sensitive to “proper lighting”. I was at a health fair and very excited to use this app. Unfortunately I was not able to get it to work properly. I was finally able to take the persons photo. Once with Wi-Fi turned on and twice without Wi-Fi. It took the photo all 3 times But then it kicked me out twice after the picture snapped and the 3rd time it said “Whoops something went wrong.... “. Any suggestions to improve this would be helpful. It’s an excellent tool when it works!!
Kathy Goshey
215-359-8090

So awesome for on the go!. What an awesome app to recommend product for our customers and allow them to shop as we meet. They can see real-time results and recommendations.

I’ve been waiting for this!!!. It’s so easy to use and provides such good info about what’s really happening with the skin

Human + Technology = Great Customer Service. I love how this app removes any perceived bias on the part of the beauty advisor. The customer can see for his or her self and is then provided with options that the advisor can help sort through. It is a perfect blend of technology and human advice.
